title: Associate Engineer - Packet Core
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Ericsson is currently seeking a dynamic Senior Engineer Packet Core. To ensure configuration/Trouble Tickets/Troubleshooting/Security Compliances on various Core nodes on Ericsson Network Architecture.

What you will do:

  • Monitor and manage PCN/MPBN nodes (SGW, PGW, SMF, UPF, routers, switches)
  • Ensure network uptime and SLA adherence
  • Perform routine health checks and preventive maintenance
  • Analyze and troubleshoot issues related to: Data session drops, latency, throughput degradation and Signaling failures (GTP, Diameter, BGP, OSPF, ISIS)
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and provide corrective actions
  • Coordinate with OEM/vendors for critical issues
  • Execute CRs for: Node integration/upgrades ,Traffic offloading / rehoming, Feature activation (4G, 5G SA, slicing, Qo S)
  • Validate pre/post KPIs and ensure no service impact
  • Monitor KPIs: Attach success rate, session success rate and Throughput, latency, packet loss
  • Identify bottlenecks and optimize network performance
  • Capacity planning and forecasting
  • Manage interfaces: S1-U, S5/S8, N3, N6 (PCN) , IP/MPLS (MPBN).
  • Ensure seamless integration with RAN, IMS, IN, and external networks
  • Handle critical incidents and outages
  • Lead bridge calls and coordinate cross-domain teams
  • Ensure timely resolution and communication
  • Prepare RCA reports, incident reports, and daily/weekly KPIs
  • Maintain network documentation and configurations.

The skills you bring:

  • Strong knowledge of: 4G EPC & 5G Core (SA/NSA)
  • Strong knowledge of: IP/MPLS networking (BGP, OSPF, ISIS, VRF)
  • Strong knowledge of: Protocols: GTP, Diameter, SIP (basic), TCP/IP
  • Experience with OEMs (Nokia, Ericsson, Huawei, Cisco, Juniper)
  • Good understanding of Linux/Unix basics.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience required.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: L2 Support Analyst (OCS)
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Netcracker Online Charging System (OCS) L2 Support Analyst to join our telecom production support team. In this role, you will ensure the stability, availability, and performance of mission-critical online charging platforms that support prepaid and postpaid services. You will work in a fast-paced production environment, providing L2 support, troubleshooting complex incidents, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to restore services within SLA.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:
Provide L2 production support for Netcracker OCS and related charging applications is mandatory.
Monitor application health, system performance, alarms, and services using enterprise monitoring tools.
Perform incident investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and timely service restoration.
Analyze Diameter (Gy, Ro, Gx) CCR/CCA transactions and resolve charging-related issues.
Investigate customer-impacting incidents using application logs, Graylog/Splunk, Unix logs, and SQL queries.
Execute operational activities including application start/stop, health checks, cache refresh, and configuration validation.
Support prepaid charging, balance management, voucher processing, recharge, and rating scenarios.
Validate integrations with CRM, Billing, Mediation, PCRF/PCF, IN platforms, and REST/SOAP APIs.
Coordinate with L3, development, infrastructure, and vendor teams during major incidents and deployments.
Prepare RCA reports, SOPs, operational documentation, and knowledge articles.
Participate in change implementation, deployment validation, and provide 24×7 production support through rotational shifts.

Required Skills:
3–8 years of experience in telecom production support.
Strong expertise in Netcracker Online Charging System (OCS).
Good understanding of Telecom BSS/OSS, prepaid/postpaid charging, and online charging concepts.
Hands-on experience with Diameter protocols (Gy, Ro, Gx).
Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting fundamentals, and SQL (Oracle/Postgre SQL/Maria DB).
Experience with log analysis tools such as Graylog, ELK, or Splunk.
Knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, ITIL processes, and application integration architecture.

Preferred Skills:
Netcracker Revenue Management (NRM).
Kubernetes, Docker, Open Shift, or cloud platforms.
Jenkins/CI-CD, Kafka, Tibco/MQ.
Monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, or App Dynamics.
Familiarity with telecom protocols including SMPP, HTTP, and Diameter.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunications, or a related field. ITIL Foundation certification and exposure to Netcracker Telecom BSS products are preferred.

title: Global Business Development Lead - Telco Security
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About the Opportunity


We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial Global Business Development Lead to drive the growth of our Cybersecurity Consulting Services business within Ericsson Cybersecurity Consulting FA. This role focuses on building a high‑growth portfolio of consulting services and integrated security solutions, leveraging Ericsson’s strengths across products, security platforms, and global service capabilities.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain a strong perspective on leading Mobile Telco security trends and consulting offerings across 5G security, Zero Trust, OT security, AI security, Quantum security and more.
  • Lead global revenue growth strategy for security consulting services across all Market Areas, defining KPIs, metrics, and performance targets.
  • Identify and shape new business opportunities, develop compelling proposals, close deals, and form strategic alliances with partners and specialist security providers.
  • Own the global security consulting portfolio including service development, pricing strategies, commercialization, and go‑to‑market execution.
  • Build and manage strategic delivery partnerships with consulting firms and niche security companies.
  • Oversee P&L management, ensuring alignment to revenue goals, profitability, cost optimization, and resource allocation.
  • Strengthen relationships with Customer Units, Account Managers, and Market Area leadership to drive consulting engagement pull‑through.
  • Lead and mentor global teams, collaborate with peer Consulting leaders and Solution Area heads, and drive excellence across regions.
  • Engage with senior sales leaders to understand customer priorities and position consulting solutions to CSPs and enterprise clients.

Note: This is a global role and requires up to 75% international travel.

What You Will Bring

Behavioral Competencies

  • Exceptional communication, executive‑level presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and ability to translate market insights into business development strategies.
  • Proven history of achieving or exceeding revenue targets in a complex consulting or services environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong financial acumen, negotiation skills, and ability to manage complex deals.
  • Ability to influence without authority and lead cross‑functional teams globally.
  • Expertise in structuring consulting contracts and navigating multi-party agreements.
  • Customer‑centric approach with a focus on long‑term value creation and delivering results.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related fields; Master’s preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in business development, sales, or consulting roles.
  • 10+ years in telecommunications or cybersecurity with demonstrated success in security services.
  • Minimum 5 years in global leadership roles with clear revenue outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of telecom security across 2G/3G/4G/5G and frameworks including GSMA, 3GPP, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and other industry standards.
  • Knowledge of security domains such as vulnerability management, penetration testing, SOC services, compliance, and risk management.
  • Experience in service development, pricing models, and commercialization of professional services.
  • Strong financial modeling and business case development skills.
  • Track record of managing multi‑million‑dollar deals through full sales cycles.
  • Security certifications (CISSP, CISA, CISM) are an advantage.

title: Inbound Supply Manager
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

We are excited to announce an opening for the role of Inbound Supply Manager! This role is tasked with ensuring short-and long-term material availability through effective management of our inbound supply chains, including external suppliers, Ericsson Supply Sites, and Contract Manufacturing Sites (EMS). An integral part of achieving stakeholder satisfaction, this position serves as a bridge between Rand D, Production Management, and Sourcing departments. If you're ready to develop and optimize the usage of time and capital resources, ensure correct dimensioning, maintain inventories throughout the supply chain, and grow supplier relations, this might be your ideal fit.

What you will do:

  • Drive a plan-driven supply chain by ensuring execution aligns with the agreed demand and supply plan
  • Monitor and manage supply chain deviations, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions
  • Ensure service level to customer (KPI)
  • Control inventory level according to supply strategy (KPI)
  • Coordinate and optimize demand planning globally and regionally
  • Supply chain risk prediction
  • Provide material availability to customer
  • Secure purchase agreement compliance
  • Purchase order handling
  • Supplier performance management
  • Track inbound shipment status
  • Support demands from other hubs
  • Excess management

The skills you bring:

  • Experience in Supply Palnning.
  • Experience in Procurement and Purchasing
  • Good in Excel /SAP knowledge / Power BI
  • Basic Knowledge in IBP - Integrated Business Planning
  • Market insights.
  • Ericsson Portfolio.

About this opportunity:

We are excited to announce an opening for the role of Inbound Supply Manager! This role is tasked with ensuring short-and long-term material availability through effective management of our inbound supply chains, including external suppliers, Ericsson Supply Sites, and Contract Manufacturing Sites (EMS). An integral part of achieving stakeholder satisfaction, this position serves as a bridge between Rand D, Production Management, and Sourcing departments. If you're ready to develop and optimize the usage of time and capital resources, ensure correct dimensioning, maintain inventories throughout the supply chain, and grow supplier relations, this might be your ideal fit.

What you will do:

  • Drive a plan-driven supply chain by ensuring execution aligns with the agreed demand and supply plan
  • Monitor and manage supply chain deviations, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions
  • Ensure service level to customer (KPI)
  • Control inventory level according to supply strategy (KPI)
  • Coordinate and optimize demand planning globally and regionally
  • Supply chain risk prediction
  • Provide material availability to customer
  • Secure purchase agreement compliance
  • Purchase order handling
  • Supplier performance management
  • Track inbound shipment status
  • Support demands from other hubs
  • Excess management

The skills you bring:

  • Experience in Supply Palnning.
  • Experience in Procurement and Purchasing
  • Good in Excel /SAP knowledge / Power BI
  • Basic Knowledge in IBP - Integrated Business Planning
  • Market insights.
  • Ericsson Portfolio.

Why join Ericsson?

At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

We are excited to announce an opening for the role of Inbound Supply Manager! This role is tasked with ensuring short-and long-term material availability through effective management of our inbound supply chains, including external suppliers, Ericsson Supply Sites, and Contract Manufacturing Sites (EMS). An integral part of achieving stakeholder satisfaction, this position serves as a bridge between Rand D, Production Management, and Sourcing departments. If you're ready to develop and optimize the usage of time and capital resources, ensure correct dimensioning, maintain inventories throughout the supply chain, and grow supplier relations, this might be your ideal fit.

What you will do:

  • Drive a plan-driven supply chain by ensuring execution aligns with the agreed demand and supply plan
  • Monitor and manage supply chain deviations, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions
  • Ensure service level to customer (KPI)
  • Control inventory level according to supply strategy (KPI)
  • Coordinate and optimize demand planning globally and regionally
  • Supply chain risk prediction
  • Provide material availability to customer
  • Secure purchase agreement compliance
  • Purchase order handling
  • Supplier performance management
  • Track inbound shipment status
  • Support demands from other hubs
  • Excess management

The skills you bring:

  • Experience in Supply Palnning.
  • Experience in Procurement and Purchasing
  • Good in Excel /SAP knowledge / Power BI
  • Basic Knowledge in IBP - Integrated Business Planning
  • Market insights.
  • Ericsson Portfolio.

Why join Ericsson?

At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. Join our Team

About this opportunity:

We are excited to announce an opening for the role of Inbound Supply Manager! This role is tasked with ensuring short-and long-term material availability through effective management of our inbound supply chains, including external suppliers, Ericsson Supply Sites, and Contract Manufacturing Sites (EMS). An integral part of achieving stakeholder satisfaction, this position serves as a bridge between Rand D, Production Management, and Sourcing departments. If you're ready to develop and optimize the usage of time and capital resources, ensure correct dimensioning, maintain inventories throughout the supply chain, and grow supplier relations, this might be your ideal fit.

What you will do:

  • Drive a plan-driven supply chain by ensuring execution aligns with the agreed demand and supply plan
  • Monitor and manage supply chain deviations, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions
  • Ensure service level to customer (KPI)
  • Control inventory level according to supply strategy (KPI)
  • Coordinate and optimize demand planning globally and regionally
  • Supply chain risk prediction
  • Provide material availability to customer
  • Secure purchase agreement compliance
  • Purchase order handling
  • Supplier performance management
  • Track inbound shipment status
  • Support demands from other hubs
  • Excess management

The skills you bring:

  • Experience in Supply Palnning.
  • Experience in Procurement and Purchasing
  • Good in Excel /SAP knowledge / Power BI
  • Basic Knowledge in IBP - Integrated Business Planning
  • Market insights.
  • Ericsson Portfolio.

Why join Ericsson?

At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

title: Packet core Engineer/Architect
jobDescription:
About this opportunity

About this opportunity:


Join Ericsson as an Integration Engineer, an integral role where you will have the opportunity to manage and implement integration services. you have to work closely with regional counterparts in customer Solution Designing, High Level Design/ Low Level Design based on the requirements. Ability to accept and deliver assistance to meet deadlines, self-directed, organized, capable of multi-tasking and willing to shift priorities to meet business.


What you will do:


• Plan and execute Packet Core upgrades (SGSN-MME, AMF, SMF, UPF,CCPC,SAPC,WMG,EPG 3.x)
• Perform pre-checks, health checks, and post-upgrade validations
• Execute software installation, patching, and traffic migration activities
• Ensure service continuity during maintenance windows and traffic cutovers
• Troubleshoot integration and post-upgrade issues across network elements
• Work closely with Solution Architects, Design, and Operations teams
• Support rollback planning and execution in case of failures
• Maintain and update Method of Procedure (Mo P) and documentation
• Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Shell preferred)
• Ensure compliance with customer SLAs and quality standards


The skills you bring:


Strong knowledge of 4G EPC & 5G Core architecture
• Hands-on experience with: MME / SGW / PGW/ AMF / SMF / UPF / PCF
• Linux/Unix systems
• Virtualization / Cloud (Open Stack, Kubernetes)
• CI/CD tools (optional but preferred)
• Log analysis and tracing tools
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
• Ability to work in high-pressure maintenance windows
• Good stakeholder communication and coordination
• Customer-facing experience preferred
• Successful execution of upgrade activities with zero/low service impact
• Accurate and timely reporting & documentation
• Reduction in manual effort via automation
• Improved network stability post upgrades

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Primary country and city: India (IN) ||

experienceProfile.rawText: About this opportunity About this opportunity: Join Ericsson as an Integration Engineer, an integral role where you will have the opportunity to manage and implement integration services. you have to work closely with regional counterparts in customer Solution Designing, High Level Design/ Low Level Design based on the requirements. Ability to accept and deliver assistance to meet deadlines, self-directed, organized, capable of multi-tasking and willing to shift priorities to meet business. What you will do: • Plan and execute Packet Core upgrades (SGSN-MME, AMF, SMF, UPF,CCPC,SAPC,WMG,EPG 3.x) • Perform pre-checks, health checks, and post-upgrade validations • Execute software installation, patching, and traffic migration activities • Ensure service continuity during maintenance windows and traffic cutovers • Troubleshoot integration and post-upgrade issues across network elements • Work closely with Solution Architects, Design, and Operations teams • Support rollback planning and execution in case of failures • Maintain and update Method of Procedure (Mo P) and documentation • Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Shell preferred) • Ensure compliance with customer SLAs and quality standards The skills you bring: Strong knowledge of 4G EPC & 5G Core architecture • Hands-on experience with: MME / SGW / PGW/ AMF / SMF / UPF / PCF • Linux/Unix systems • Virtualization / Cloud (Open Stack, Kubernetes) • CI/CD tools (optional but preferred) • Log analysis and tracing tools • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills • Ability to work in high-pressure maintenance windows • Good stakeholder communication and coordination • Customer-facing experience preferred • Successful execution of upgrade activities with zero/low service impact • Accurate and timely reporting & documentation • Reduction in manual effort via automation • Improved network stability post upgrades Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world's toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won't be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next. What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. description:
About this opportunity

About this opportunity:


Join Ericsson as an Integration Engineer, an integral role where you will have the opportunity to manage and implement integration services. you have to work closely with regional counterparts in customer Solution Designing, High Level Design/ Low Level Design based on the requirements. Ability to accept and deliver assistance to meet deadlines, self-directed, organized, capable of multi-tasking and willing to shift priorities to meet business.


What you will do:


• Plan and execute Packet Core upgrades (SGSN-MME, AMF, SMF, UPF,CCPC,SAPC,WMG,EPG 3.x)
• Perform pre-checks, health checks, and post-upgrade validations
• Execute software installation, patching, and traffic migration activities
• Ensure service continuity during maintenance windows and traffic cutovers
• Troubleshoot integration and post-upgrade issues across network elements
• Work closely with Solution Architects, Design, and Operations teams
• Support rollback planning and execution in case of failures
• Maintain and update Method of Procedure (Mo P) and documentation
• Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Shell preferred)
• Ensure compliance with customer SLAs and quality standards


The skills you bring:


Strong knowledge of 4G EPC & 5G Core architecture
• Hands-on experience with: MME / SGW / PGW/ AMF / SMF / UPF / PCF
• Linux/Unix systems
• Virtualization / Cloud (Open Stack, Kubernetes)
• CI/CD tools (optional but preferred)
• Log analysis and tracing tools
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
• Ability to work in high-pressure maintenance windows
• Good stakeholder communication and coordination
• Customer-facing experience preferred
• Successful execution of upgrade activities with zero/low service impact
• Accurate and timely reporting & documentation
• Reduction in manual effort via automation
• Improved network stability post upgrades

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Primary country and city: India (IN) ||

title: Senior Telco Business Consultant
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this Opportunity

Ericsson Global Consulting is looking for a highly qualified Strategy Consultant at the Senior/ Principal position to advise leading Communications Service Providers (CSPs) on their most strategic business and technology transformations.

Prior experience in a pure-play management consulting firm or in a dedicated business/ strategy consulting role within the telecommunications industry is mandatory.

As a trusted advisor to C-level executives and senior business and technology leaders, you will shape growth strategies, define business models, and develop transformation roadmaps across 5G Standalone (SA), Network Slicing, Private Networks, AI, Telco Cloud, OSS/BSS, Io T, and digital services.

This is a highly client-facing role that combines strategy consulting, business development, consulting sales, and thought leadership to help customers unlock new revenue opportunities and accelerate innovation.

The role is Global, and you will travel internationally based on customer demand.

What you will do

  • Lead strategic consulting engagements for global telecom operators across 5G, Network Slicing, Private Networks, Telco Cloud, OSS/BSS, AI and digital transformation.
  • Advise C-level executives on growth strategy, technology investments, monetization, business models, pricing, operating models and go-to-market strategies.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and facilitate executive workshops to influence strategic decisions.
  • Develop market assessments, business cases, commercial strategies and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Partner with Ericsson account teams to identify consulting opportunities, support sales pursuits, develop proposals and contribute to consulting revenue growth.
  • Help achieve consulting sales targets by expanding existing accounts and developing new business opportunities.
  • Develop consulting methodologies, reusable assets and thought leadership on emerging telecom trends including 5G SA, Network Slicing and enterprise connectivity.
  • Mentor consultants, lead workstreams and ensure high-quality delivery across global consulting engagements.

What you will bring

  • 10+ years of experience in management consulting or telecommunications strategy consulting.
  • Mandatory experience in a pure-play consulting firm or a dedicated business/ strategy consulting role within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven experience engaging with CXO/ ‘CXO-1’-level stakeholders and leading strategic transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience in business development, consulting sales, proposal development and revenue growth.
  • Strong expertise in one or more of the following domains: 5G SA, Network Slicing, Private Networks, Telco Cloud, OSS/BSS, AI, Io T, Digital Transformation or Enterprise Connectivity.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in business case development, pricing, monetization and go-to-market strategy.
  • Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology; MBA from a leading business school is preferred.

“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
jobDescription:
Join our Team

What you will do

• 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud-native platforms, networking, and enterprise architecture.
• Strong expertise in Kubernetes, CNIS, CCD, container ecosystems, and platform engineering.
• Deep understanding of Software Defined Infrastructure technologies.
• Strong experience in enterprise networking, SDN, Juniper, and Extreme Networks.


The skills you bring

• End-to-end administration and operations of CNIS platforms including Kubernetes, container runtimes, and cloud-native infrastructure components.
• Manage and optimize Cloud Container Distribution (CCD), covering provisioning, upgrades, backup/restore, lifecycle management, and disaster recovery readiness.
• Perform CCD health checks, configuration drift analysis, capacity tracking, and environment validation across clusters.
• Work closely with app and platform teams to onboard workloads and provide CCD-level support.
• Monitor system performance and availability using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and other tools
• Maintain detailed runbooks, MOPs, and CNIS documentation for operational readiness.
• Define and govern CNIS architecture, platform standards, and design principles for Kubernetes-based environments.
• Lead design reviews and capacity planning for CNIS and CCD platforms.
• Define platform lifecycle strategies covering deployment, upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and decommissioning.
• Establish multi-cluster architecture, workload placement strategies, and platform segmentation models.
• Drive adoption of Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C), Git Ops, and automation frameworks.
• Define observability architecture using Prometheus, Grafana, logging, tracing, and monitoring platforms.
• Lead platform modernization and transformation initiatives.
• Lead DR planning, execution, and RCA of major incidents.

SDI (Software Defined Infrastructure) Administration:
• Design and govern Software Defined Infrastructure architectures spanning compute, storage, and networking domains.
• Good Hands on experience of SDN, Calico, Multus, service networking, and container networking solutions.
• Design scalable storage architectures leveraging Ceph, SDS, CSI drivers, and persistent storage solutions.
• Lead infrastructure integration across CNIS, SDI, storage, and networking layers.


Enterprise Networking:
• Strong hands-on experience with Juniper and Extreme Networks switches:
• Understanding of SDN and integration with container networking layers (e.g., Calico).
• Familiarity with traffic filtering, isolation, and multi-tenant CNIS network architecture.
• Switch boot process, firmware upgrades, backup/restore,Border leaf switch management and troubleshooting
• Configuration of VLANs, trunking, port profiles (access/trunk), and ACLs
• Performance analysis, component replacement, switch stacking, and chassis management

Linux System Administration:
• Expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) system administration and troubleshooting.
• Experience with:
o Cluster-level configurations
o LVM management
o Multipathing (MPIO) setup and troubleshooting
o Patch management, firmware upgrades, and OS-level tuning
o Scheduling and validating backups/recoveries
o Performance troubleshooting, kernel-level analysis, and log auditing.
o Hands-on with SAN topology, host-side storage integration, and network storage troubleshooting.
o Hardware troubleshooting experience on HP Pro Liant, Dell Power Edge servers.

Location - Hyderebad/Bangalore

title: Support Engineer Cloud
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Support Engineer is working to provide solutions to problems that have been reported by customers according to established processes and contracted Service Level Agreements. The support Engineer has product/domain, and/or solutions knowledge and/or customer networks knowledge as well as knowledge of technology evolution of product/domain. In case additional services are contracted with the customer the Support engineer will also handle e.g., Pre-emptive and Software Update handling.
Related to Problem Management, Support Engineer is responsible for the implementation of preventive actions and reporting results of implementation.

We have 2 Positions in Gurgaon and 1 in Mumbai


Responsibility and Tasks
General
• Handle and resolve Customer issues
• Provide dedicated support
• Deliver results & meet customer expectations
• Handle Software Update Management (SUM)
• Handle Customers and internal Stakeholders from Technical perspective
• Work with diverse team

Operational
• Keep track of ongoing Customer service request and ensure that concern is being addressed with the right priority
• Analyze and troubleshoot to Handle and provide support in critical and Emergency cases when needed
• Interface and Interact with the relevant stockholders within organization and ensure the timely progress on Customer service request for Critical/ Priority cases
• Available to handle customer technical queries all the time and ensure timely response
• Make constant efforts to be updated on relevant technical skills all the time
• Participate in Project activities and involve as needed
• Take handover from Project and ensure all the check points completed
• Organize and deliver the Knowledge sharing sessions with stakeholders
• Review and prepare the relevant technical document i.e. RCA

Customer Specific
• Good Working Relationship with Customer and Working groups

title: Senior 5G System Developer
jobDescription:
Join our Team

At Ericsson, we are the world leader in 5G innovation and deployment, powering a connected future where technology improves the way we live and work. With unmatched expertise and market penetration in 5G New Radio (NR), we are shaping the future of communication – and pioneering advancements that will lead us into the era of 6G.

The Opportunity:

For the first time, we are opening doors for highly skilled GPP 5G L1/L2 systems designers in India to be part of our global development teams. This is your chance to contribute directly to the evolution of Ericsson 5G NR and play a critical role in defining how millions connect and communicate worldwide.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform systemization for features in Scheduler, Radio Physical Layer and Radio Resource Management for radio functions like Beam Forming, Massive MIMO, Carrier Aggregation, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing
  • Specify new 5G system features and functions, including requirements, test cases, algorithms, use cases, parameter settings and address any interactions with legacy features and functionality
  • Develop software simulations for the performance analysis of features and algorithms either link-level or network-level simulations.
  • Drive continuous improvements of products, simulation tools and processes
  • Support system verification and perform analysis of test results with respect to operator KPIs.
  • Support the deployment of new 5G & 6G products and features into customer networks. Work with Customer troubleshooting and analysis. Understand customer configurations and issues.

Required QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong background in communications theory and digital signal processing
  • Solid understanding of LTE & NR 3GPP specifications, especially in the areas of the Physical Layer, Radio Resource Management and Mobility
  • Experience in SW development for Link and Network Simulations. Languages include: Java, C and C++, Python, matlab
  • 5+ years of experience in doing System & Link Level Simulation or 10+ years telecom software development with specialization in 5G L2 Algorithms conceptualization, design, and development with strong fundamental on L1 blocks and concepts
  • Analytical mindset and result orientation to deliver even when under pressure• Ability to multi-task, meet deadlines and manage many different projects at once
  • M.Tech. or Ph.D. degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics, or related field, preferably with proven experience and knowledge in the above- mentioned required skills areas

All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification

title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

BNEW RCE Lab Operations provides lab infrastructure, networks, and hardware services that enable R&D teams to configure and deploy design and test environments globally.

Hardware Management (HWM) provides hardware asset management for R&D, covering the full asset lifecycle to support data-driven decisions and maximize value.

Join Ericsson as a Dev Sec Ops Engineer and help build, secure, and operate COS (Central Observability System), the platform behind our global observability services used by thousands of developers and testers worldwide.

We’re hiring a Dev Sec Ops Engineer to evolve and run COS (Central Observability System), Ericsson’s global observability platform. Join our journey into secure automation and AI-enabled operations.

COS is used daily by thousands of developers and testers worldwide. You’ll own the Dev Sec Ops setup end-to-end: secure CI/CD, infrastructure/configuration as code, operational readiness, and continuous improvement. You’ll also help introduce AI, from AIOps workflows to MLOps/LLMOps pipelines keeping features safe, observable, and reliable.

Tech stack spans cloud-native microservices (e.g., Go, Svelte, Kubernetes), telemetry backends (e.g., Cortex), and data systems (e.g., Postgres/Cassandra/Kafka).

You like automation, clear guardrails, and measurable outcomes. You turn telemetry into action and help teams move fast without compromising security or reliability.


What you will do

  • Build and run COS as a secure cloud-native platform (containers, Kubernetes, Open Stack), using infrastructure/configuration as code.
  • Introduce AI-enabled operations (AIOps) and MLOps/LLMOps practices: automate detection/diagnosis, and set up safe, observable delivery and monitoring of AI components.
  • Execute deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes; troubleshoot by reproducing issues, restoring service, and running performance/load tests as needed.
  • Improve secure CI/CD for platform and services: testing, scanning, policy checks, controlled releases, and compliance (risk assessments, audits, configuration baselines).
  • Apply SRE practices to improve availability, scalability, and performance, and drive proactive monitoring and reliability improvements.
  • Take operational ownership with the team: runbooks, on-call readiness, incident/problem management, SLA follow-up, access management, and service performance reporting.

The skills you bring

  • 5–8+ years in Dev Sec Ops or platform engineering in a cloud-native environment, with end-to-end ownership across build and run.
  • Strong CI/CD and automation skills, including security checks (SAST/SCA, image scanning, policy checks) and controlled releases.
  • Solid understanding of cloud-native observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki) and instrumentation with Open Telemetry.
  • Comfortable working across a broad tech stack and learning new tools and concepts quickly.
  • Clear communicator who collaborates globally and can explain our work across development, operations, and security. You enjoy mentoring and sharing practices in the team/community.
  • Proactive problem-solver who thrives in hands-on engineering and structured delivery, and enjoys making production systems secure, predictable, and observable.
  • Merit: AI platform engineering (MLOps/LLMOps), deploying/monitoring LLM services, RAG pipelines, and embeddings/vector search. Ericsson experience is a plus.

  • “All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”

Req ID: 784372

title: Storage Admin
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join as a Storage Systems Administrator to manage and support enterprise storage environments (IBM, Pure Storage, EMC VMAX/Power Max, HPE 3PAR), SAN fabric (Cisco MDS/Brocade), and backup/recovery (EMC Net Worker/Data Domain), delivering reliable storage services and customer-facing solutions.

What you will do:

Install, configure, monitor, and maintain enterprise storage arrays and SAN switches. Manage backup and recovery operations, including performing backups and restores. Plan capacity and tune performance to meet service levels. Implement and manage replication solutions (e.g., SRDF, Snap Mirror) and other data-protection features. Apply firmware and patch upgrades while minimizing service disruption. Troubleshoot storage, SAN, and backup issues and raise OEM support tickets when required. Collaborate with IT teams and customers to provision storage and deliver customer-facing solutions. Follow change-management processes and contribute to disaster recovery planning.

The skills you bring:

Hands-on experience with IBM storage (Flash System, XIV, Spectrum Scale, DS). Experience with Pure Storage Flash Arrays. Experience with EMC platforms (VMAX/Power Max, Xtrem IO, Unity) and/or HPE 3PAR. Strong knowledge of SAN fabric technologies, especially Cisco MDS and Brocade. Expertise in backup/recovery tools and appliances, notably EMC Net Worker and Data Domain. Proven troubleshooting skills, capacity planning, and performance tuning experience. Familiarity with replication technologies (SRDF, Snap Mirror) and DR practices. Experience with firmware/patch management, change control, and raising OEM tickets. Clear customer-facing communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across teams.

description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join as a Storage Systems Administrator to manage and support enterprise storage environments (IBM, Pure Storage, EMC VMAX/Power Max, HPE 3PAR), SAN fabric (Cisco MDS/Brocade), and backup/recovery (EMC Net Worker/Data Domain), delivering reliable storage services and customer-facing solutions.

What you will do:

Install, configure, monitor, and maintain enterprise storage arrays and SAN switches. Manage backup and recovery operations, including performing backups and restores. Plan capacity and tune performance to meet service levels. Implement and manage replication solutions (e.g., SRDF, Snap Mirror) and other data-protection features. Apply firmware and patch upgrades while minimizing service disruption. Troubleshoot storage, SAN, and backup issues and raise OEM support tickets when required. Collaborate with IT teams and customers to provision storage and deliver customer-facing solutions. Follow change-management processes and contribute to disaster recovery planning.

The skills you bring:

Hands-on experience with IBM storage (Flash System, XIV, Spectrum Scale, DS). Experience with Pure Storage Flash Arrays. Experience with EMC platforms (VMAX/Power Max, Xtrem IO, Unity) and/or HPE 3PAR. Strong knowledge of SAN fabric technologies, especially Cisco MDS and Brocade. Expertise in backup/recovery tools and appliances, notably EMC Net Worker and Data Domain. Proven troubleshooting skills, capacity planning, and performance tuning experience. Familiarity with replication technologies (SRDF, Snap Mirror) and DR practices. Experience with firmware/patch management, change control, and raising OEM tickets. Clear customer-facing communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across teams.

title: Lead Admin - Windows & Vmware
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About This Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to manage and support our virtualized and Windows server environments. You will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and availability of critical infrastructure services across VMware and Windows platforms.

What You Will Do

Manage and troubleshoot VMware v Sphere environments (v Center, ESXi 6.5/7.0/8.0)
Perform VM provisioning, migration (v Motion/Storage v Motion), and resource optimization
Handle HA, DRS, and VM snapshot management
Support v DS and performance tuning
Work on ESXi patching, upgrades, and host profile management
Create and maintain automation scripts (Power CLI preferred)
Manage Windows Server OS (2012/2016/2019/2022)
Handle DHCP and Hyper-V management
Perform patch management and Windows clustering support
Troubleshoot OS-level issues including performance bottlenecks
Perform backup and restore activities

The Skills You Bring

10+ years of experience in VMware and Windows Server administration
Strong hands-on knowledge of v Sphere, ESXi, and v Center
Experience with Windows Server management and clustering
Proficiency in Power CLI or similar scripting tools
Good communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities
Ability to provide 24x7 support and work from office


Location : Bangalore

title: WFM Solution Architect
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join Ericsson's Managed Services Delivery Platform (MSDP) team and be part of a high-impact Solution Development group at the heart of how we manage customer networks globally. The Workforce Management (WFM) system is a critical component of our MSDP portfolio, enabling efficient work order distribution, field force scheduling, and end-to-end network operations across multi-customer and multi-country environments. As a WFM Solution Architect, you will own the technical delivery of product solutions, driving continuous improvement across the full lifecycle of the WFM platform.

What you will do:

Lead end-to-end solution design and delivery on the WFM platform — from requirement gathering through to testing, release, and go-live support.
Act as Technical Lead for business requirement implementation, including preparation of solution descriptions, estimation, and gap analysis.
Serve as the key interface between customers, pre-sales leads, release managers, scrum masters, and delivery managers.
Facilitate security standards and drive risk management procedures within the program.
Develop and maintain solution documentation for implementers, customers, operations, and support teams.
Provide on-site customer support during testing and go-live phases to ensure successful deployment.
Contribute to capacity planning, performance enhancement, and continuous product improvement initiatives.
Deliver technical training to both customer technical staff and internal teams.

The skills you bring:

Hands-on experience with Workforce Management tools, specifically the IFS suite (FSM & PSO), including administration, business rules configuration, and customer adaptations.
Strong development expertise in Microsoft .NET (C#), XML, XSL, Web Services, and IIS.
Proficiency in Angular JS, HTML5, Java Script, and Oracle databases.
Experience with SDLC and technical leadership across design, coding, testing, and integration phases, including Java/PLSQL/.NET code reviews.
Familiarity with Dev Ops tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket, and Ansible for CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of cloud-based architectures and the ability to rapidly adapt to new technologies.
Knowledge of telecom operations frameworks such as e TOM and ITIL.
Excellent problem-solving, consultative, and stakeholder management skills with experience working in agile, matrixed, and international environments.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Primary country and city: India (IN) || Gurgaon

experienceProfile.rawText: Join our Team About this opportunity: Join Ericsson's Managed Services Delivery Platform (MSDP) team and be part of a high-impact Solution Development group at the heart of how we manage customer networks globally. The Workforce Management (WFM) system is a critical component of our MSDP portfolio, enabling efficient work order distribution, field force scheduling, and end-to-end network operations across multi-customer and multi-country environments. As a WFM Solution Architect, you will own the technical delivery of product solutions, driving continuous improvement across the full lifecycle of the WFM platform. What you will do: Lead end-to-end solution design and delivery on the WFM platform - from requirement gathering through to testing, release, and go-live support. Act as Technical Lead for business requirement implementation, including preparation of solution descriptions, estimation, and gap analysis. Serve as the key interface between customers, pre-sales leads, release managers, scrum masters, and delivery managers. Facilitate security standards and drive risk management procedures within the program. Develop and maintain solution documentation for implementers, customers, operations, and support teams. Provide on-site customer support during testing and go-live phases to ensure successful deployment. Contribute to capacity planning, performance enhancement, and continuous product improvement initiatives. Deliver technical training to both customer technical staff and internal teams. The skills you bring: Hands-on experience with Workforce Management tools, specifically the IFS suite (FSM & PSO), including administration, business rules configuration, and customer adaptations. description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join Ericsson's Managed Services Delivery Platform (MSDP) team and be part of a high-impact Solution Development group at the heart of how we manage customer networks globally. The Workforce Management (WFM) system is a critical component of our MSDP portfolio, enabling efficient work order distribution, field force scheduling, and end-to-end network operations across multi-customer and multi-country environments. As a WFM Solution Architect, you will own the technical delivery of product solutions, driving continuous improvement across the full lifecycle of the WFM platform.

What you will do:

Lead end-to-end solution design and delivery on the WFM platform — from requirement gathering through to testing, release, and go-live support.
Act as Technical Lead for business requirement implementation, including preparation of solution descriptions, estimation, and gap analysis.
Serve as the key interface between customers, pre-sales leads, release managers, scrum masters, and delivery managers.
Facilitate security standards and drive risk management procedures within the program.
Develop and maintain solution documentation for implementers, customers, operations, and support teams.
Provide on-site customer support during testing and go-live phases to ensure successful deployment.
Contribute to capacity planning, performance enhancement, and continuous product improvement initiatives.
Deliver technical training to both customer technical staff and internal teams.

The skills you bring:

Hands-on experience with Workforce Management tools, specifically the IFS suite (FSM & PSO), including administration, business rules configuration, and customer adaptations.
Strong development expertise in Microsoft .NET (C#), XML, XSL, Web Services, and IIS.
Proficiency in Angular JS, HTML5, Java Script, and Oracle databases.
Experience with SDLC and technical leadership across design, coding, testing, and integration phases, including Java/PLSQL/.NET code reviews.
Familiarity with Dev Ops tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket, and Ansible for CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of cloud-based architectures and the ability to rapidly adapt to new technologies.
Knowledge of telecom operations frameworks such as e TOM and ITIL.
Excellent problem-solving, consultative, and stakeholder management skills with experience working in agile, matrixed, and international environments.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Linux Administrator
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Ericsson is very passionate about learning and development, supports mobility and flexible working hours. We are also committed to diversity and inclusion and to be a responsible and relevant driver of positive change. We also offer some awesome benefits, outstanding career development and training programs to provide an empowered career in a connected world.

Our team provides system administration support for multiple Telecom service provider across the globe. We provide support for Linux, Solaris, AIX operation system, Automation of activities through Ansible/Shell scripts, Dockers, Kubernetes, Open Shift and other associated Public cloud technologies.

What you will do:

  • You will be a System admin team supporting single/multiple telecom service provider for Linux & Ansible activities.
  • Your role will be to ensure high customer satisfaction.
  • Your role will be to ensure high uptime and working of technical environment.
  • Need to work with multiple internal and external teams to perform the work.
  • Should be flexible to work as per the work requirement.
  • Should learn new technology and keep updated as per the changes in technologies.
  • Should share achievements and knowledge to help others and address others' need.

The skills you bring:

  • 5+ years of Linux administration experience working in a medium to large complex highly process oriented global IT infra environment.
  • Experience in Redhat Enterprise Linux Administration (RHEL 6/7/8), Performance tuning, Capacity Planning, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience in LVM & Filesystem management and File/Directory Permissions.
  • Experience in Patching and security best practices and vulnerability assessment with Selinux, Firewall and Iptables knowledge.
  • Experience in installing and configuring various network services like NFS, SQUID, DNS, Apache, FTP/SFTP, NTP, SMTP etc.
  • Experience in Redhat PCS cluster administration.
  • Working/Basic knowledge VMware virtualization.
  • Experience in Ansible playbook automation.
  • Knowledge on scheduling backups & recovery.

“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Primary country and city: India (IN) ||

title: Technical Authority Expert_ DealerApp
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Enterprise Applications team is now looking for skilled professionals to support and manage critical enterprise systems in a 24×7 production environment. The role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, deployments, and ensuring high availability, performance, and SLA compliance across complex application stacks. Please share suitable profiles for consideration.

What you will do:

Application L2 Production support Including but not limited to:

  • Monitoring of the production system & ensuring its performance and stability
  • Action on issues reported by L1/monitoring teams. Coordination with L3/vendor team for restoration of any faults
  • Trouble Tickets resolution – Resolve day to day customer issues
  • Coordination with IT/network teams to resolve any operational or functional issues
  • Responsible for answering adhoc requests from various teams
  • Analyze the Logs and try resolving the issues, escalate issues well in advance and suggest alternative approaches
  • Analyse and Automate Healthchecks, Performance metrics related data extraction etc
  • Deploy CRs on production environments and ensure smooth system performance
  • Folow ITIL processes and exhibit expertise in Incident, Problem and change management
  • Ensure SLA compliance for application and trouble tickets
  • Proactive competence development of self in new solution areas & certifications
  • Provide an effective 360-degree feedback on the ailing elements in the current solution and co-ordinate with Design team/L3/ Vendor to fix them

The skills you bring:

Must Haves:

  1. Hands-on experience in troubleshooting enterprise SOAP/REST API-based applications running on Open Shift Container Platform (OCP).
  2. Proficient in HPSM ticket management and production monitoring using Grafana, App Dynamics, and Nagios.
  3. Proficient in Kibana/grey-log analysis for API transaction tracing, exception analysis, production incident investigation, application defect, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  4. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex production issues, support application deployments, and ensure stable and reliable service delivery.

Good to have:

  • Understanding of an APK Support (versed with supporting a hand-held Tablet based application) for both android and apple devices.
  • Basic understanding of telecom domain and other integrated applications like Billing Systems, EAI/ Messaging platforms, Payment gateway etc.
  • Knowledge of deployment and maintenance of web-based applications
  • Strong knowledge of Linux command-line environment
  • Experience in web application development and support
  • Good knowledge of J2EE, EJB, Servlets, Design Patterns, Spring
  • Strong learning and time management skills
  • Team player capable of working independently
  • Should be willing to work in 24*7 environment
  • Good communication skills


“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”

description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Enterprise Applications team is now looking for skilled professionals to support and manage critical enterprise systems in a 24×7 production environment. The role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, deployments, and ensuring high availability, performance, and SLA compliance across complex application stacks. Please share suitable profiles for consideration.

What you will do:

Application L2 Production support Including but not limited to:

  • Monitoring of the production system & ensuring its performance and stability
  • Action on issues reported by L1/monitoring teams. Coordination with L3/vendor team for restoration of any faults
  • Trouble Tickets resolution – Resolve day to day customer issues
  • Coordination with IT/network teams to resolve any operational or functional issues
  • Responsible for answering adhoc requests from various teams
  • Analyze the Logs and try resolving the issues, escalate issues well in advance and suggest alternative approaches
  • Analyse and Automate Healthchecks, Performance metrics related data extraction etc
  • Deploy CRs on production environments and ensure smooth system performance
  • Folow ITIL processes and exhibit expertise in Incident, Problem and change management
  • Ensure SLA compliance for application and trouble tickets
  • Proactive competence development of self in new solution areas & certifications
  • Provide an effective 360-degree feedback on the ailing elements in the current solution and co-ordinate with Design team/L3/ Vendor to fix them

The skills you bring:

Must Haves:

  1. Hands-on experience in troubleshooting enterprise SOAP/REST API-based applications running on Open Shift Container Platform (OCP).
  2. Proficient in HPSM ticket management and production monitoring using Grafana, App Dynamics, and Nagios.
  3. Proficient in Kibana/grey-log analysis for API transaction tracing, exception analysis, production incident investigation, application defect, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  4. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex production issues, support application deployments, and ensure stable and reliable service delivery.

Good to have:

  • Understanding of an APK Support (versed with supporting a hand-held Tablet based application) for both android and apple devices.
  • Basic understanding of telecom domain and other integrated applications like Billing Systems, EAI/ Messaging platforms, Payment gateway etc.
  • Knowledge of deployment and maintenance of web-based applications
  • Strong knowledge of Linux command-line environment
  • Experience in web application development and support
  • Good knowledge of J2EE, EJB, Servlets, Design Patterns, Spring
  • Strong learning and time management skills
  • Team player capable of working independently
  • Should be willing to work in 24*7 environment
  • Good communication skills


“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”

title: Solution Architect - Packet Core
jobDescription:
Grow with us

About this opportunity!

Summary


This is an exciting opportunity for a Solution Architect-Packet Core within the Ericsson, S&R Packet Core Sub-Domain. In this role, you will be part of a dedicated team responsible for supporting Ericsson's customers across various network solutions.

The S&R Solution Architect-Packet Core is part of a CNS (Customer Network Support) team supporting the customer and shall deliver in-service Support services according to the contracted agreements by means of established processes.

As telecom networks increasingly adopt cloud-based and virtualized infrastructure, this role plays a critical part in navigating the complexities of modern operations, fault isolation, and customer service requests (CSRs).

You will be key in ensuring Ericsson’s 4G & 5G Cloud and Packet Core solutions are seamlessly delivered, supported, and continually optimized for performance.

This role is ideal for individuals looking to work in a dynamic, innovative environment that challenges them to blend both traditional telecom and IT methodologies for exceptional customer outcomes.

What you will do


• Lead Fault Isolation & Solution Emergency Handling: Serve as the Technical leader during critical CSRs and network emergencies, ensuring rapid fault resolution and network recovery.
• Continuous Customer Support Handover: Ensure a continuous, adaptive handover process established within the customer’s change management system & Project evolving it from a one-time to an ongoing activity.
• Develop Network Recovery Procedures: Own and enhance recovery procedures for issues like signaling storms, traffic rerouting, and other network recovery activities.
• Support Product-Specific Requests: Provide technical support for product-specific CSRs when needed, contributing to a smooth, end-to-end support process.
• Collaborate with Customer Operations Teams: Work on-site with customer teams, acting as the technical interface for complex network troubleshooting and recovery efforts.
• Manage Solution Lifecycle: Control the lifecycle management (LCM) status of customer-specific solutions, coordinating deployment, upgrades, and corrections.
• Contribute to Business Growth: Actively engage with customer networks and strategies to identify additional sales opportunities, promoting Ericsson’s products and services.
• Customer consultation handling on Solution level

title: Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:
Welcome to an exciting opportunity at Ericsson, where you'll step into the role of a Data Engineer working on high-volume, low-latency data platforms powering next-gen Gen AI systems, AI agents, and enterprise copilots for Telecom OSS/BSS. We build production-grade systems that drive automation, intelligence, and decisioning at scale. Real systems, Real impact.

What you will do:
Build and operate large-scale, high-throughput data systems handling massive datasets
Develop complex, scalable solutions using Python and Java
Design and optimize distributed data pipelines using Apache Spark
Engineer low-latency, high-performance data processing systems (batch+streaming)
Work with Cassandra and Open Search/Elasticsearch for high availability and scale
Develop scalable backend services and REST APIs (Spring Boot-based microservices)
Experience to work with AWS (Kiro) / Microsoft Copilot stack
Develop MCP-based applications and integrations with enterprise systems
Build RAG pipelines across network, service, customer, and operational data
Engineer data pipelines for embeddings, vector stores, and retrieval systems
Implement end-to-end Data/MLOps pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, and CI/CD
Ensure system performance, scalability, observability, and reliability
Manage and mitigate FOSS (Free & Open Source Software) vulnerabilities using security scanning and patching practices

The skills you bring:
Strong Python and Java expertise with experience building production-grade systems is mandatory
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (Py Spark/Scala/Java) and distributed processing
Proven experience in high-volume, low-latency system design and optimization
Strong knowledge of Cassandra, Open Search/Elasticsearch, and No SQL data modeling is mandatory
Experience building scalable APIs and microservices (Spring Boot)
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)
Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with vulnerability management and non functional features(alarm , logging , fault management etc)
Good understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, and Gen AI data pipelines
Exposure to developer copilots / AI-assisted coding tools

Good to have:
Telecom OSS/BSS domain knowledge (business + data)
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms
Understanding of AI observability, explainability, and responsible AI

description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:
Welcome to an exciting opportunity at Ericsson, where you'll step into the role of a Data Engineer working on high-volume, low-latency data platforms powering next-gen Gen AI systems, AI agents, and enterprise copilots for Telecom OSS/BSS. We build production-grade systems that drive automation, intelligence, and decisioning at scale. Real systems, Real impact.

What you will do:
Build and operate large-scale, high-throughput data systems handling massive datasets
Develop complex, scalable solutions using Python and Java
Design and optimize distributed data pipelines using Apache Spark
Engineer low-latency, high-performance data processing systems (batch+streaming)
Work with Cassandra and Open Search/Elasticsearch for high availability and scale
Develop scalable backend services and REST APIs (Spring Boot-based microservices)
Experience to work with AWS (Kiro) / Microsoft Copilot stack
Develop MCP-based applications and integrations with enterprise systems
Build RAG pipelines across network, service, customer, and operational data
Engineer data pipelines for embeddings, vector stores, and retrieval systems
Implement end-to-end Data/MLOps pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, and CI/CD
Ensure system performance, scalability, observability, and reliability
Manage and mitigate FOSS (Free & Open Source Software) vulnerabilities using security scanning and patching practices

The skills you bring:
Strong Python and Java expertise with experience building production-grade systems is mandatory
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark (Py Spark/Scala/Java) and distributed processing
Proven experience in high-volume, low-latency system design and optimization
Strong knowledge of Cassandra, Open Search/Elasticsearch, and No SQL data modeling is mandatory
Experience building scalable APIs and microservices (Spring Boot)
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP)
Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with vulnerability management and non functional features(alarm , logging , fault management etc)
Good understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, and Gen AI data pipelines
Exposure to developer copilots / AI-assisted coding tools

Good to have:
Telecom OSS/BSS domain knowledge (business + data)
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms
Understanding of AI observability, explainability, and responsible AI

title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Join our Team

About the Role
Ericsson is looking for a passionate Data Scientist to build next-generation AI solutions for Telecom OSS/BSS. You will design and deliver production-grade AI Agents, Enterprise Copilots, and intelligent automation using Generative AI, LLMs/SLMs, Knowledge Graphs, and cloud-native AI platforms to solve complex business problems at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop production-grade Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
Build Enterprise Copilots using LLMs/SLMs, MCP, RAG, and Graph RAG.
Develop Knowledge Management solutions leveraging Knowledge Graphs, vector databases, and enterprise data.
Train, fine-tune, optimize, and evaluate LLMs/SLMs for domain-specific use cases.
Build scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Deliver enterprise AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI.
Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven business outcomes.

Required Skills
Strong foundation in Statistics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Expert Python programming with experience building production-grade AI/Gen AI applications.
Hands-on experience with AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Enterprise Copilots, RAG, Graph RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks.
Strong understanding of Knowledge Management, Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search, and enterprise retrieval architectures.
Experience developing MCP (Model Context Protocol)-based applications.
Experience training, fine-tuning, and optimizing LLMs/SLMs.
Expertise in AWS Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI, including Agent Core/Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Prompt Management, Model Customization, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and enterprise AI deployment.
Experience with cloud-native development, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and MLOps.

Preferred Qualifications
Telecom OSS/BSS domain knowledge.
Experience with AI Reasoning, Agent Memory, Planning, and Tool Use.
Knowledge of AI Observability, Explainability, Responsible AI, and Governance.
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, MLflow, or similar AI platforms.
Master's/Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI/ML are an added advantage.

experienceProfile.rawText: Join our Team About the Role Ericsson is looking for a passionate Data Scientist to build next-generation AI solutions for Telecom OSS/BSS. You will design and deliver production-grade AI Agents, Enterprise Copilots, and intelligent automation using Generative AI, LLMs/SLMs, Knowledge Graphs, and cloud-native AI platforms to solve complex business problems at scale. Key Responsibilities Design and develop production-grade Gen AI applications and AI Agents. Build Enterprise Copilots using LLMs/SLMs, MCP, RAG, and Graph RAG. Develop Knowledge Management solutions leveraging Knowledge Graphs, vector databases, and enterprise data. Train, fine-tune, optimize, and evaluate LLMs/SLMs for domain-specific use cases. Build scalable Python-based AI services and APIs. Deliver enterprise AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI. Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven business outcomes. Required Skills Strong foundation in Statistics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI. Expert Python programming with experience building production-grade AI/Gen AI applications. Hands-on experience with AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Enterprise Copilots, RAG, Graph RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks. Strong understanding of Knowledge Management, Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search, and enterprise retrieval architectures. Experience developing MCP (Model Context Protocol)-based applications. Experience training, fine-tuning, and optimizing LLMs/SLMs. Expertise in AWS Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI, including Agent Core/Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Prompt Management, Model Customization, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and enterprise AI deployment. Experience with cloud-native development, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and MLOps. Preferred Qualifications Telecom OSS/BSS domain knowledge. Experience with AI Reasoning, Agent Memory, Planning, and Tool Use. Knowledge of AI Observability, Explainability, Responsible AI, and Governance. Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, MLflow, or similar AI platforms. Master's/Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field is preferred. Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI/ML are an added advantage. About the Role
Ericsson is looking for a passionate Data Scientist to build next-generation AI solutions for Telecom OSS/BSS. You will design and deliver production-grade AI Agents, Enterprise Copilots, and intelligent automation using Generative AI, LLMs/SLMs, Knowledge Graphs, and cloud-native AI platforms to solve complex business problems at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop production-grade Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
Build Enterprise Copilots using LLMs/SLMs, MCP, RAG, and Graph RAG.
Develop Knowledge Management solutions leveraging Knowledge Graphs, vector databases, and enterprise data.
Train, fine-tune, optimize, and evaluate LLMs/SLMs for domain-specific use cases.
Build scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Deliver enterprise AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI.
Collaborate with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven business outcomes.

Required Skills
Strong foundation in Statistics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Expert Python programming with experience building production-grade AI/Gen AI applications.
Hands-on experience with AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Enterprise Copilots, RAG, Graph RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks.
Strong understanding of Knowledge Management, Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search, and enterprise retrieval architectures.
Experience developing MCP (Model Context Protocol)-based applications.
Experience training, fine-tuning, and optimizing LLMs/SLMs.
Expertise in AWS Bedrock and/or Google Vertex AI, including Agent Core/Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Prompt Management, Model Customization, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and enterprise AI deployment.
Experience with cloud-native development, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and MLOps.

Preferred Qualifications
Telecom OSS/BSS domain knowledge.
Experience with AI Reasoning, Agent Memory, Planning, and Tool Use.
Knowledge of AI Observability, Explainability, Responsible AI, and Governance.
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, MLflow, or similar AI platforms.
Master's/Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI/ML are an added advantage.
